tui_runtime_widgets_event_paused_by: Line of the TUI sidebar event log when an action paused a service. {subject} is the service, {by} the action's label.
tui_runtime_widgets_events_empty: Line under the heading of the TUI sidebar event log when nothing happened yet.
tui_runtime_widgets_events_title: Heading of the event log in the TUI sidebar; shown in capitals.
tui_runtime_widgets_health_degraded: Part of the health summary of the TUI sidebar: services that answer but are not ready.
tui_runtime_widgets_health_done: Part of the health summary of the TUI sidebar: one-shot services that finished well.
tui_runtime_widgets_health_running: Start of the health summary in the TUI sidebar and status strip: services running of those expected.
tui_runtime_widgets_health_stopped: Part of the health summary of the TUI sidebar: services stopped by hand.
tui_runtime_widgets_health_unhealthy: Part of the health summary of the TUI sidebar: services alive but not answering their health check.
tui_runtime_widgets_level_all: Label of the log level filter in the TUI: every line.
tui_runtime_widgets_level_error: Label of the log level filter in the TUI: errors only.
tui_runtime_widgets_level_warn: Label of the log level filter in the TUI: warnings and errors.
tui_runtime_widgets_log_new_lines: Chip at the bottom of the TUI log view while paused: lines that arrived since. {key} is the key that jumps to the bottom.
tui_runtime_widgets_log_no_matches: Centered text of the TUI log view when a search or filter matches nothing. {tab} is the tab's name.
tui_runtime_widgets_mem_budget: Fact under a service in the TUI sidebar about its memory (and in `atlas dev --status`, in English). {budget} is the standing against the memory budget.
tui_runtime_widgets_mem_budget_ok: Fact under a service in the TUI sidebar about its memory (and in `atlas dev --status`, in English). Budget standing: within budget.
tui_runtime_widgets_mem_budget_over: Fact under a service in the TUI sidebar about its memory (and in `atlas dev --status`, in English). Budget standing: above the budget.
tui_runtime_widgets_mem_budget_warn: Fact under a service in the TUI sidebar about its memory (and in `atlas dev --status`, in English). Budget standing: close to the budget.
tui_runtime_widgets_mem_falling: Fact under a service in the TUI sidebar about its memory (and in `atlas dev --status`, in English). Trend word: memory shrinks.
tui_runtime_widgets_mem_flat: Fact under a service in the TUI sidebar about its memory (and in `atlas dev --status`, in English). Trend word: memory is steady.
tui_runtime_widgets_mem_rising: Fact under a service in the TUI sidebar about its memory (and in `atlas dev --status`, in English). Trend word: memory grows.
tui_runtime_widgets_mem_size: Fact under a service in the TUI sidebar about its memory (and in `atlas dev --status`, in English). {size} is a size such as 1.2 GiB.
tui_runtime_widgets_mem_trend: Fact under a service in the TUI sidebar about its memory (and in `atlas dev --status`, in English). {direction} is the trend word, {rate} a signed number.
tui_runtime_widgets_palette_no_match: Counter of the TUI command palette when no command matches the query.
tui_runtime_widgets_phase_detecting: Badge of a mobile build session in the TUI sidebar: looking for devices.
tui_runtime_widgets_phase_failed: Badge of a mobile build session in the TUI sidebar: the build or deploy failed.
tui_runtime_widgets_phase_install: Badge of a mobile build session in the TUI sidebar: installing the app on the device.
tui_runtime_widgets_phase_launch: Badge of a mobile build session in the TUI sidebar: starting the app.
tui_runtime_widgets_phase_running: Badge of a mobile build session in the TUI sidebar and footer: the app runs.
tui_runtime_widgets_range_all: Label of the TUI log time range: no limit.
tui_runtime_widgets_range_end_before_sta: Error under the custom time range prompt of the TUI when the range ends before it starts.
tui_runtime_widgets_range_from: Label of the custom TUI log time range with no end. {time} is a clock time (HH:MM).
tui_runtime_widgets_range_last_hours: Label of the TUI log time range: the last N hours.
tui_runtime_widgets_range_last_minutes: Label of the TUI log time range: the last N minutes.
tui_runtime_widgets_range_not_a_time: Error under the custom time range prompt of the TUI. {input} is the text that is not a clock time.
tui_runtime_widgets_range_since_restart: Label of the TUI log time range: from the latest restart of the viewed service.
tui_runtime_widgets_range_since_start: Label of the TUI log time range: from the first line of the run.
tui_runtime_widgets_range_type_a_time: Error under the custom time range prompt of the TUI when it is empty. The times are examples.
tui_runtime_widgets_search_filter: Label of the TUI log search mode that shows only matching lines.
tui_runtime_widgets_search_find: Label of the TUI log search mode that highlights matches and keeps every line.
tui_runtime_widgets_sidebar_all_ok: Health line of the TUI sidebar when every service is up.
tui_runtime_widgets_sidebar_exit: Tail of a failed service row in the TUI sidebar: the exit code of its process.
tui_runtime_widgets_sidebar_failed: Row under the issues heading of the TUI sidebar. {name} is the service.
tui_runtime_widgets_sidebar_issues: Heading of the critical failures in the TUI sidebar; shown in capitals after a warning sign. i18n-allow dnt:issue (a list of failures, not GitHub issues)
tui_runtime_widgets_sidebar_mobile: Heading of the mobile build sessions in the TUI sidebar; shown in capitals.
tui_runtime_widgets_sidebar_no_services: Health line of the TUI sidebar when the project has no services.
tui_runtime_widgets_sidebar_off: Tail of a service row in the TUI sidebar: the service was left out of this run (`atlas dev SERVICE`).
tui_runtime_widgets_sidebar_operations: Heading of the running atlas.yaml action in the TUI sidebar; shown in capitals.
tui_runtime_widgets_sidebar_services: Heading of the service list in the TUI sidebar; shown in capitals.
tui_runtime_widgets_sidebar_tunnel: Heading of the SSH tunnel block of the TUI sidebar; shown in capitals.
tui_runtime_widgets_sidebar_tunnel_kill: Checkbox row of the TUI sidebar: whether quitting also closes the tunnel.
tui_runtime_widgets_sidebar_tunnel_off: Tunnel row of the TUI sidebar when no tunnel is open.
tui_runtime_widgets_tab_all: Name of the first tab of the TUI, which shows every service together.
